pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **In the cutthroat world of fantasy soccer, there is no greater crime than Mustard Boy's lackluster roster crawling in at third place!** Zach, let me tell you something pal: your Brazil pick might have the samba flair, but your team drafts are about as bland as a bucket of plain mustard. The Swiss did bail you out with a penalty shoot-out win over Colombia, but you better pray they can keep squeezing out magic, because your hopes ride on them like a dollar store pony! Now let's talk about Bubba G — Gunner, you've got France and Morocco clashing, like you're playing chess with yourself. But let's be honest, with two teams eating away each other's points, it's like watching you trying to pick up the pieces of a self-inflicted implosion, and for some reason, I see the French Le Coq crowing at the end. The Backpass Assassin, here's a lesson for you: while your England squad might dream of coming home, your selections are certainly going nowhere fast — Japan and Ivory Coast are about as potent as a discarded banger. Ghost Pepper, Devin, LOOK AT ME. You put your faith in Spain and the USA and somehow you seem to be the only one who thinks that's enough to win a World Cup fantasy draft. And finally, The Noisemaker — Rafe, my child, you may have Germany, but your drafting strategy makes as much sense as a silent soccer stadium. You're young and inexperienced, but even you have to see that Germany's last hurrah can't save you from your mishaps. Remember these words, gentlemen: standings are a reflection of life, and if you're at the bottom, maybe it's time to rethink what that says about who you are.
